description: Rungs where closurec's output differs from the pinned oracle. Each entry pins the current closurec output so the gap cannot silently widen, and so closing it fails the harness — which is the signal to delete the entry.

ladder_t3_function_expr_advanced.reason: closurec does not propagate a single-use function expression to its call site and eliminate the binding.

ladder_t3_iife_advanced.reason: closurec does not inline an immediately invoked function expression.

ladder_t3_nested_fn_advanced.reason: closurec does not inline a single-use nested function. `inline` is registered only under ADVANCED, and even there handles a narrower case than upstream.

ladder_t3_nested_fn_simple.reason: closurec does not inline a single-use nested function. `inline` is registered only under ADVANCED, and even there handles a narrower case than upstream.

ladder_t3_unused_local_advanced.reason: closurec does not remove a function-local binding that is never read. `remove-unused-vars` is gated to ADVANCED, but upstream removes scope-local bindings at SIMPLE too, where the open-world contract does not apply.

ladder_t3_unused_local_simple.reason: closurec does not remove a function-local binding that is never read. `remove-unused-vars` is gated to ADVANCED, but upstream removes scope-local bindings at SIMPLE too, where the open-world contract does not apply.

ladder_t4_for_loop_advanced.reason: closurec does not rename loop-header locals. Upstream renames `i` to `a`. This is the CCR-022 renaming-breadth gap.

ladder_t4_if_else_advanced.reason: closurec does not propagate a known binding into the condition, so the branch survives as a ternary instead of collapsing. Upstream folds it away entirely. This is the CCR-068 value-propagation gap.

ladder_t4_if_else_simple.reason: closurec does not propagate a known binding into the condition, so the branch survives as a ternary instead of collapsing. Upstream folds it away entirely. This is the CCR-068 value-propagation gap.

ladder_t4_switch_advanced.reason: Upstream propagates the scrutinee `x = 1`, selects the live case and discards the rest of the switch, leaving only its effect. closurec emits the input. This is the CCR-068 value-propagation gap.

ladder_t4_switch_simple.reason: Upstream terminates the switch statement after its closing brace; closurec places a semicolon inside the block instead. Emitter punctuation only — both forms parse identically. This is CCR-073.

ladder_t4_try_catch_advanced.reason: Two causes, the same as the SIMPLE rung: the catch parameter is not renamed (CCR-022) and the try statement is not terminated after its closing brace (CCR-073). ADVANCED adds no further difference here.

ladder_t4_try_catch_simple.reason: Two causes. Upstream renames the catch parameter `e` to `a`, which closurec skips (CCR-022), and terminates the try statement after its closing brace, which closurec omits (CCR-073). Both must be fixed before this rung matches.

ladder_t4_while_advanced.reason: closurec rewrites the while into a for but leaves the initializer as a separate statement rather than hoisting it into the for header (CCR-074). The ADVANCED rung additionally needs the loop-local rename of CCR-022.

ladder_t4_while_simple.reason: closurec rewrites the while into a for but leaves the initializer as a separate statement rather than hoisting it into the for header (CCR-074). The ADVANCED rung additionally needs the loop-local rename of CCR-022.

ladder_t5_array_advanced.reason: closurec does not propagate a single-use array literal into its use site and eliminate the binding (CCR-068).

ladder_t5_nested_obj_advanced.reason: closurec does not propagate a single-use nested object literal through a property chain to its use site (CCR-068).

ladder_t5_object_advanced.reason: closurec does not propagate a single-use object literal into its use site and eliminate the binding. This is the CCR-068 value-propagation gap — the single largest contributor to the ADVANCED ladder result.

ladder_t5_quoted_key_advanced.reason: closurec does not propagate a single-use object literal read through a quoted key (CCR-068).

ladder_t5_regex_advanced.reason: closurec does not propagate a single-use regular-expression literal into its use site (CCR-068).
